title: Add bee orient as the second sweep call site
action: Call the sad-1 sweep from bee orient, and only from bee orient (per D1). One run() body serves both verbs (orient.rs:454-459 branches Verb::Status and Verb::Orient), so the call must sit inside the Verb::Orient branch and before the report is rendered at orient.rs:497 - attaching at :499, where record_timing sits, would make bee status sweep and would print the report from pre-sweep state. Resolve the caller session with resolve_session_flag_env (claims.rs:627-634, env BEE_SESSION_ID then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID) and then resolve_session_adopt (claims.rs:638-652); per D6, when both fail, report the count of expired claims detected and write nothing at all - resolve_session_adopt returns None exactly when several live sessions exist, which is the case this feature targets, and sweeping anonymously there would defeat sad-1's exclusion. Follow the prior art at status_full/recovery.rs:270-283, where detect_crash_candidates already excludes the current session by env id. Bridge the error types rather than unifying them: cells uses MR<T> = Result<T, Fail> (cells/util.rs:36) and status_full uses R<T> = Result<T, Ex> (status_full/mod.rs:157). orient's arg routing is a closed six-shape match at orient.rs:441-449 and gains no new shape - no --session-id flag. Finally correct the orient entry in src/generated/registry_payload.json, whose description still calls orient a 'Read-only session-start context packet' while it now sweeps; the payload is compiled in via include_str! (registry.rs:3-13) and renders --help, no regen chain covers it (bee dev regen is render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write per router.rs:90-92), and src/generated is write-guarded at hooks/write_guard/guards.rs:216 - follow the remedy the guard's own denial names, never disable the guard. Note that orient already writes today (record_timing appends .bee/logs/timings.jsonl, verbs/mod.rs:99-107), so this is not the first write on the path. Judge existing coverage in status_full/tests.rs first; a binary-level test under packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/ is the right home for an end-to-end orient invocation because orient::run reads std::env::current_dir() at orient.rs:455.

the orient entry in registry_payload.json no longer describes the command as read-only
